answer: Adoption records can bridge one agent to one real family. Three established peers pull the file from the civil registry, match the names with the case number, and confirm the adoption is real. One record anchors one identity forever; a second on the same record is refused. Forging one takes a fake court order, a bribed clerk, and two staged witnesses: $7,000 and four months per fake identity, while a real family clears in minutes. A sybil farm would need an orchard of fake families per puppet. Identity should hang like a lantern over a real home, not a story told in the dark.
